description.zh: 把踩点工程导出为 A Dance of Fire and Ice (.adofai) 关卡：双押/多押、快速跑动、发卡处理、Pause 补偿、近整拍吸附，支持旧版(0.2)/新版(0.3)两种核心模型，并可生成装饰泳道与多轨预览。
description.en: Export the project as a Dance of Fire and Ice (.adofai) level with double/multi press, rapid runs, hairpins, pause compensation and beat snapping. Dual core models (legacy 0.2 / modern 0.3), decoration lanes and multi-track preview.
